تصطخبن (form VIII)
# تَصْطَخِبْنَ (taṣṭaḵibna) /tasˤ.tˤa.xib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# تُصْطَخَبْنَ (tuṣṭaḵabna) /tusˤ.tˤa.xab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
